name: Personalized Vinyl Record Guest Book
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and acrylic, offering a sturdy, elegant, and memorable keepsake finish.
    - Features a layered construction combining wooden panels, a clear acrylic lid, and a vinyl record-style guest book sign for a unique display.
    - The acrylic panel is made with a 3mm thickness, providing a clear and durable surface for signatures and messages.
    - Wooden components are made with 3mm thickness, helping create a solid structure and refined decorative look.
    - Includes a metal hinge and wooden stand for secure display and convenient presentation.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Closed book size: 14 x 14 in ~ 35.56 x 35.56 cm
    - Round sign size: 12 x 12 in ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vivid colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Guest book sign: 2-sided printing
    - Lid Layer 1: 1-sided printing
    - Lid Layer 2: 2-sided printing
    - Lid Layer 3: 1-sided printing
    - Rotating shaft: 1-sided printing
    - Box Layer 1: 2-sided printing
    - Box Layer 2: 1-sided printing
    - Box Layer 3: 1-sided printing
    - Box Layer 4: 1-sided printing
    - Support bar: 2-sided printing

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a guest book and a decorative keepsake display.
    - Designed for weddings, anniversaries, engagement parties, birthdays, graduation parties, retirement celebrations, and other meaningful events.
    - Guests can sign the acrylic guest book sign to leave messages, names, or well wishes.
    - The hinged box design allows the guest book to be stored and displayed beautifully after the event.
    - Comes with a wooden stand, making it easy to showcase on a welcome table, memory table, or shelf after the celebration.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, engagements, birthdays, graduations, retirements, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for music lovers, vinyl record fans, and anyone who enjoys unique personalized event décor.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for preserving names, signatures, and heartfelt messages from guests.
    - Great for event décor, memory tables, and long-term home display after the special day.
    - Adds a stylish, sentimental, and memorable touch to any celebration🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Vinyl Record Guest Book

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
